sources.note: The only source with first-hand Sindihui data (Josserand code 'sind', 188-set wordlist, segmental only). Its comparison of 16 Mixtec phonological systems and Proto-Mixtec overview may contain a general Mixtec stress statement (couplet-initial stress) and possibly notes on the Sindihui list; needs a page check to confirm whether Sindihui is one of the 16 systems.
